visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young girls sit at a light-colored wooden table. The girl on the right wears a white T-shirt with a hamburger graphic, while the younger girl on the left is in a white tank top. They look at the camera with joyful expressions and squinted eyes, throwing their hands up in a cheering gesture. The background shows a modern kitchen with a large vent hood and gray tiled walls. (2) An adult's hand enters the frame, moving bowls of yellow corn and white rice. The girls lean forward, focusing on a small white plastic rice mold. They use white plastic spoons to move food, their small hands gripping the utensils tightly. The lighting is bright and natural, reflecting off the table surface. (3) The girls use their fingers to press the rice into the mold, showing concentrated facial expressions and slightly messy hands. The adult woman, wearing a purple shirt, helps flip the mold onto a white plate. Text captions appear at the bottom of the frame in white, providing dialogue. (4) The mold is lifted, revealing a decorated circular rice ball. The girls' eyes widen in surprise and they begin to clap enthusiastically. They pick up dark green seaweed sheets and pieces of the rice ball, placing them into their mouths. The kitchen background remains consistent with neutral colors. (5) A flat pink screen transitions into view, featuring a centered cartoon illustration of a young girl with brown pigtails sitting atop a large orange peach. The text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE" is displayed in white, sans-serif font below the graphic. The lighting is flat and uniform as it is a graphic background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a heartwarming lifestyle vlog documenting a family cooking activity. It aims to capture the genuine joy and curiosity of two young girls as they interact with their mother to create a simple meal. By showcasing the step-by-step process of molding a rice ball and the children's enthusiastic reaction to the successful result, the video appeals to viewers interested in parenting, family bonding, and cute child-centric content. The combination of bright visual tones, upbeat acoustic music, and expressive vocal interactions creates a high-valence, positive emotional experience for the audience.
